historical_original_semantics: The archived command evaluated 200 ordered seeds from 90000 on CUDA device 0, using one reused SOFA scene. Its evaluator constructed the environment once, loaded the Original TD-MPC2 checkpoint, called set_seed(seed) and env.reset(seed=seed) in order, and selected agent.act(..., eval_mode=True) with Safety-MPC disabled.
g1b_evaluator_delta_from_archived_lifecy: Explicit env.action_space.seed(seed) before env.reset, as required by G1B. Evaluation actions never sample from action_space, so this does not enter the policy trajectory; no safety or force code is active.
scene_lifecycle: One newly created SOFA scene per checkpoint evaluation run; the same scene is reset and reused for every ordered seed in that run. No environment recreation between episode seeds.
seed_order_per_checkpoint: 91000..91099 inclusive, identical order for all six candidates
confirmation_seed_order: 90000..90199 inclusive, run only after selected_checkpoint.json is frozen
rng_order: set_seed(seed_start) before environment/agent construction; each episode then set_seed(seed), env.action_space.seed(seed), env.reset(seed=seed), agent.act(eval_mode=True, first_step=(episode_length==0))
checkpoint_loading: format-1 G1 TD-MPC2 full checkpoint loaded on CPU, embedded config verified against frozen G1 config; new Original agent initialized on CUDA and model state loaded with load_optimizers=False; checkpoint file SHA256 locked by manifest
action_reward_observation_task: Frozen G1 Original 14-D normalized observation, 2-D normalized action, target/path-length navigation reward and 200-step task horizon; no force signal enters any of these
incremental_output: CSV row flushed after each completed episode
resume_semantics: On --resume, instantiate a new scene and replay every already-saved seed from the beginning, checking success, length, reward and trajectory SHA256; append only new seeds. Never skip to a later seed with a fresh scene.
